Class UserDAO

java.lang.Object
com.mycompany.beautybajar.dao.UserDAO
public class UserDAO extends Object
UserDAO — Data Access Object for all database operations on the users table. Provides methods to insert, retrieve, update, and delete user records. All database connections are obtained via DBConnection.getConnection().

  • Method Details

    • insertUser

      public boolean insertUser(User user)
      Inserts a new user record into the users table. The role is automatically set to "user" regardless of the User object's role field, ensuring no one can register as admin through the normal registration flow.
      Parameters:
      user - the User object containing fullName, username, email, password , phone, and address
      Returns:
      true if the record was inserted successfully; false if a database error occurred

    • getUserByUsername

      public User getUserByUsername(String username)
      Retrieves a single user record by their username. Used during login to fetch the stored BCrypt hash for password verification.
      Parameters:
      username - the username to search for (case-sensitive)
      Returns:
      the matching User object, or null if not found

    • getUserByEmail

      public User getUserByEmail(String email)
      Retrieves a single user record by their email address. Used during registration to check for duplicate emails before inserting.
      Parameters:
      email - the email address to search for
      Returns:
      the matching User object, or null if not found

    • getUserByPhone

      public User getUserByPhone(String phone)
      Retrieves a single user record by their phone number. Used during registration to check for duplicate phone numbers.
      Parameters:
      phone - the 10-digit phone number to search for
      Returns:
      the matching User object, or null if not found

    • getUserById

      public User getUserById(int userId)
      Retrieves a user record by their unique user ID. Used on the profile page to load full user details from the session's stored userId.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user to retrieve
      Returns:
      the matching User object, or null if not found

    • getAllUsers

      public List<User> getAllUsers(String search)
      Retrieves all users from the database, with optional search filtering. If a non-empty search string is provided, filters by username or email using LIKE. Used by the admin user management panel.
      Parameters:
      search - the search keyword to filter by username or email; pass null or empty string to return all users
      Returns:
      a List of User objects matching the criteria; returns an empty list if no users are found

    • deleteUser

      public boolean deleteUser(int userId)
      Deletes a user record from the database by their user ID. Due to the ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key on the orders table, all orders belonging to this user are also deleted automatically.
      Parameters:
      userId - the primary key of the user to delete
      Returns:
      true if the record was deleted successfully; false if no record was found or a database error occurred

    • countUsers

      public int countUsers()
      Returns the total number of registered users in the database. Used to display the user count stat card on the admin dashboard.
      Returns:
      the total count of users as an int; returns 0 if a database error occurs
